author: Sample A.
body: Placeholder review. The team explained every option and the costs before we started, and the visits always ran on time.

author: Sample B.
body: Placeholder review. Our daughter was nervous at the first visit, but the orthodontist talked her through each step and she now looks forward to check-ups.

author: Sample C.
body: Placeholder review. The 3D scan took a few minutes and I could see exactly how my teeth would move before agreeing to treatment.

author: Sample D.
body: Placeholder review. Friendly front desk, clear written plan, and they called back the same day when I had a question about my aligners.

author: Sample E.
body: Placeholder review. They looked at my son's breathing and jaw growth, not just his teeth, and referred us on when it was outside their scope.
